subject: Post-discovery: schedule 75min technical deep-dive & draft agenda
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Santos <emily.santos@medinova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule 75min technical deep-dive & draft agenda

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for a great discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with your infra and ML engineering teams to validate integration points, performance expectations, and deployment model (hosted vs. dedicated).
- Primary topics we should cover: networking/data flow, model size & quantization options, expected QPS and latency targets, KV-cache and caching patterns, and a short demo of a representative inference run (30–40min ops + 30min Q&A).

Would you be able to lock a 75-minute slot with your infra lead + one ML engineer? Below are windows I can offer next week (all PT):
  • Tue Aug 6 — 09:00–10:15 or 13:00–14:15
  • Wed Aug 7 — 11:00–12:15
  • Thu Aug 8 — 15:00–16:15

If none of those work, send a couple options and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) with scope items and owners — helps guide the session.

Draft agenda (can refine):
  1) 5’ — Introductions and success criteria
  2) 15’ — Architecture & data flow (your infra constraints)
  3) 25’ — Redwood demo: serving/runtime choices + perf examples
  4) 20’ — Integration considerations (auth, VPC/KMS, privacy)
  5) 10’ — Action items & next steps

Ben (cc) and Karthik from our ML infra team will join. Ben will handle the demo; Karthik will cover kernel/quant suggestions.

Thanks — if you reply with a preferred slot I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the pre-read.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Medinova-MAP.xlsx - spreadsheet)
